title: Bacon beacon
description: This is a very simple resource pack/ texture pack that makes the beacon have a bacon (raw pork chop) texture appear on the side of the block.
body:
This resource/texture pack plays off of an already integrated Easter egg hidden within Minecraft's achievements. This achievement is called "Bring Home the Beacon", and I would tell you what the reference is, but I am avoiding copyright infringement of any kind.

--------------------------------  
Though unlikely, I may update this in the future. I also create addons for Bedrock Edition, so I may release a bedrock version of this texture pack.  

--------------------------------  
Created by NightML aka NightMareLore. I hope you enjoy!
